y-m-11-09.s.s1.line.1: Bayan kwana 14 da 21 ma Alhamis ce.
y-m-11-09.s.s1.line.2: Bayan kwana 49 ma Alhamis ce. 50 yana kusa da 49, don haka bayan kwana 50 ma Alhamis ce.
y-m-11-09.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka bayan kwana 50 Alhamis ce.
y-m-11-09.s.s1.explain: Matsalar tana layi na 3. Maganar cewa bayan kwana 49 Alhamis ce daidai ce. Amma 50 ba 49 ba ne, don haka ba za ka ce ranar mako ɗaya ce ba. Lambobin suna kusa ba hujja ba ce cewa rana ɗaya ce. Layi na 4 hukunci ne da ya amince da kuskuren layi na 3, shi ma ba daidai ba ne. Za mu gano ranar da za ta kasance bayan kwana 50 a tambaya ta gaba.
y-m-11-09.s.s2.hint.0: Daga lambobin kwanaki da rana iri ɗaya ke dawowa, nemo mafi kusa da 50.
y-m-11-09.s.s2.hint.1: Daga ranar mako bayan wannan adadin kwanaki, ci gaba da ƙirga ranakun da suka rage.

y-m-11-09.s.s2.r.b: Wannan tunani ne na ƙara kwanakin da suka rage bayan zagaye da ya dawo da ranar mako iri ɗaya.
y-m-11-09.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunani ya ɗauki ragowar kwana 2 ne. Ƙirga bambancin kwanaki tsakanin bayan 49 da bayan 50.
y-m-11-09.s.s2.r.d: Wannan tunani ya ƙirga baya da rana ɗaya daga bayan kwana 49. Ka yi tunanin ko bayan kwana 50 ya fi gaba ko ya gabata da bayan 49.
y-m-11-09.s.s2.explain: Bayan kwana 49 Alhamis ce, bayan kwana 50 kuma rana ta gaba ce, don haka Juma'a ce. Za ka iya ganin kwana 7 sau 7 suna ba da kwana 49, kwana ɗaya kuma ya rage.

y-m-11-06.title: Hanyoyin raba alewa 24 cikin jaka-jaka
y-m-11-06.topic: Dangantakar adadin jaka da adadin alewa a jaka ɗaya (idan jimilla ta tabbata)
y-m-11-06.goal: Nemo dangantaka a jadawalin yadda adadin alewa a jaka ɗaya ke canzawa yayin da adadin jakunkuna ke ƙaruwa; yi hanyoyi da dama masu cika sharuɗɗa, sannan ka yanke hukunci kan yanayin da ba zai yiwu ba.
y-m-11-06.material:
Kana son raba alewa 24 cikin jakunkuna masu adadin iri ɗaya. Ka saka duk alewa, babu wadda ta rage. Duba jadawalin.
Idan jakunkuna 2 ne, alewa 12 a jaka ɗaya; jakunkuna 3, guda 8 a kowace; jakunkuna 4, guda 6 a kowace.
y-m-11-06.thinking.0: Fitar da dangantakar daidai a jadawali (ware dangantakar da ta yi daidai a wasu ƙwayoyin kawai)
y-m-11-06.thinking.1: Samar da hanyoyi da dama ƙarƙashin sharadi
y-m-11-06.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci kan yanayin da ba zai yiwu ba
y-m-11-06.prereq.0: Sanin lambobi a jadawalin ninkawa (matakin aji na 2–3)
y-m-11-06.prereq.1: Karanta yadda adadin abubuwa biyu ke canzawa a jadawali
y-m-11-06.s.s1.prompt: Ka duba jadawali ka zaɓi bayanin da ya fi dacewa game da dangantakar adadin jakunkuna da alewar da ke jaka ɗaya.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace ƙwaya cikin ukun, rubuta jimilla, bambanci, da ninkin lambobin biyu.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo wanda ke ba da ƙima iri ɗaya a duk ƙwayoyin uku.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.a: Duk lokacin da adadin jaka ya ƙaru da 1, alewar jaka ɗaya na raguwa da 4.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka kalli ƙwayoyi biyu na farko kawai (12→8). Ka duba ko ya ragu da 4 a ƙwaya ta uku ma (8→6).
y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.b: Idan ka haɗa adadin jakunkuna da alewa a jaka ɗaya, kullum adadi ɗaya ne za ka samu.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.b: Idan ka haɗa lambobin biyu a kowace ƙwaya, za ka samu 14, 11, 10. Duba ƙwaya bayan ƙwaya ko jimillarsu iri ɗaya ce.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.c: Idan ka ninka adadin jakunkuna da alewa a jaka ɗaya, kullum 24 ne.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.c: Wannan zaɓi ne da ya bincika ko ƙimar da lambobin biyu suka samar iri ɗaya ce a ƙwayoyi ukun.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.d: Adadin alewa a jaka ɗaya ya ninka adadin jakunkuna da 6.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.d: A ƙwaya ta farko kawai ninki 6 ne (2→12). A ƙwaya ta biyu, duba ko ninki 6 na jakunkuna 3 ya zama 8.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.explain: A ƙwayoyi ukun, samfurin ninkawa 24 ne: 2×12=24, 3×8=24, 4×6=24. Dalili kuwa alewa 24 ne gaba ɗaya. Jimilla da lambobin da suka ragu sun bambanta a kowace ƙwaya.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.prompt: Nemo yanayin da ba a cikin jadawali ba. Yi hanyoyi 2 mabambanta na saka duk alewa 24 babu saura. Adadin jaka a ya zama 5 ko fiye, jakar kowace kuma ta ƙunshi alewa b, aƙalla guda 2.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kamar ƙwayoyin jadawali ukun, zaɓi adadin jaka ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka nemo nawa ake buƙata a jaka ɗaya domin a samu 24.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.hint.1: A bar ƙwayoyin da adadin jakunkunansu ya kai 5 ko fiye kuma alewa a jaka ɗaya 2 ko fiye kawai.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Adadin jaka cikakkiyar lamba ce 5 ko fiye, adadin alewa a jaka ɗaya kuma cikakkiyar lamba ce 2 ko fiye.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Sanya adadin jaka 5 ko fiye, adadin alewa a jaka ɗaya kuma cikakkiyar lamba 2 ko fiye.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar da aka samu daga adadin jakunkuna da alewa a jaka ɗaya ba 24 ba ce. Duba dangantakar da ka gano a jadawali.
y-m-11-06.s.s2.explain: Hanyoyin da suka cika sharuɗɗan su ne jaka 6 da alewa 4 a kowace, jaka 8 da alewa 3 a kowace, da jaka 12 da alewa 2 a kowace. Jaka 4 da alewa 6 ba su cika sharadin adadin jaka aƙalla 5 ba, jaka 24 da guda 1 kuma ba ta cika sharadin aƙalla guda 2 a jaka ɗaya ba. (Canja lambobin, kamar jaka 6 da guda 4 da jaka 4 da guda 6, hanyoyi mabambanta ne.)
y-m-11-06.s.s3.prompt: Idan jakunkuna 5 ne, za ka iya saka duk alewa 24 adadi ɗaya a kowace ba tare da saura ba?
y-m-11-06.s.s3.hint.0: Canza adadin alewa a jaka ɗaya zuwa 1, 2, 3, … ka rubuta jimillar jakunkuna 5.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko akwai jimilla da ta yi daidai da 24 ko ta tsallake 24.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.o.a: Ba za a iya saka su adadi ɗaya a kowace jaka ba tare da saura ba.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne daga binciken yanayin da adadin jakunkuna da na alewar jaka cikakkun lambobi ne.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.o.b: Saka guda 4 a kowace jaka kawai.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.r.b: Jakunkuna 5 masu guda 4 a kowace su ne 20. Duba ko an saka duk alewa 24.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.o.c: Saka guda 5 a kowace jaka kawai.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.r.c: Jakunkuna 5 masu guda 5 a kowace su ne 25. Duba ko alewa 24 ce.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.o.d: Ya danganta da adadin alewar kowace jaka, don haka ban sani ba.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.r.d: Ba ka gwada yawan da zai yiwu ɗaya bayan ɗaya ba. Canza adadin zuwa 1, 2, 3, … ka rubuta jimillar.
y-m-11-06.s.s3.explain: Idan ka saka guda 4 a kowace daga jakunkuna 5, 20 ne; idan guda 5 ne, 25 ne, saboda haka babu wanda ya yi daidai da 24. Idan aka raba alewa 24 daidai cikin jakunkuna 5, ba za a raba su zuwa cikakken adadi ba, saboda haka ba zai yiwu ba.

y-m-11-01.title: Wace lamba ce ke zuwa bayan 2, 4, 8?
y-m-11-01.topic: Ƙa’idojin tsarin lambobi: yanke ko farkon lambobi iri ɗaya yana kayyade ta gaba guda ɗaya
y-m-11-01.goal: Fahimci cewa lambobin farko kaɗan na tsari ba lallai su kayyade ƙa’ida guda ɗaya ba; samar da lambobi na gaba ta amfani da ƙa’idoji daban-daban, sannan ka faɗi abin da kake bukatar ƙarin sani.
y-m-11-01.material: Jihu ta jera katunan lambobi a layi. Na ukun farko su ne 2, 4, 8. Jihu ta ce, “Kati na gaba tabbas 16 ne!” Dukkan lambobin katunan lambobin halitta ne, kuma akwai ƙa’ida da ke kayyade lamba ta gaba daga lambar da ta gabata.
y-m-11-01.thinking.0: Duba ko ikirarin “tabbas” gaskiya ne da gaske
y-m-11-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiro wata ƙa’ida daban ta kanka da ke bayyana bayanai iri ɗaya
y-m-11-01.thinking.2: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin ya wadatar da kuma faɗin abin da ake bukatar ƙarin sani
y-m-11-01.prereq.0: Kallon bambanci da ninkin tsakanin lambobi maƙwabta a tsarin lambobi (matakin aji na 3–4)
y-m-11-01.s.s1.prompt: Me kake tunani game da kalaman Jihu “Kati na gaba tabbas 16 ne”?
y-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta a gefe da gefe abin da ke canzawa da yadda yake canzawa daga 2 zuwa 4 da daga 4 zuwa 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.1: Baya ga kallon “sau nawa”, ka kuma rubuta hanyar kallon “nawa aka ƙara”, sannan ka kwatanta hanyoyin biyu.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.a: 16 daidai ne. Domin 2, 4, 8 suna ƙaruwa ta ninka lambar baya sau biyu.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.a: Gaskiya ne cewa 2, 4, 8 sun dace da ƙa’idar ninkawa biyu. Amma ba ka gwada ko akwai wata ƙa’ida da ke samar da lambobi ukun iri ɗaya ba tukuna.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.b: Za ka iya sanin ko 16 ce ne kawai bayan ka duba ko akwai wata ƙa’ida dabam da ke samar da 2, 4, 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan shi ne tunanin kada a tsaya bayan gano ƙa’ida guda, sai dai a gwada ko wata ƙa’ida za ta samar da tsarin lambobi iri ɗaya.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.c: Lambobin suna ta ƙaruwa, saboda haka kati na gaba na iya zama kowace lamba mafi girma fiye da 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa tana ƙaruwa kawai, ba ka duba yawan ƙarin a kowane lokaci ba. Yaya game da kallon alaƙar lambobi maƙwabta?
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.d: Katuna uku ne kawai, saboda haka ba za mu iya cewa akwai ƙa’ida ba kuma ba za mu iya sanin lambar gaba ba.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.d: Ba ka yi amfani da sharadin “akwai ƙa’ida” ba. Idan akwai ƙa’ida, za ka iya neman ƙa’idojin da za su yiwu daga katunan ukun.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.explain: 2, 4, 8 za su iya fitowa ta ƙa’idar “ninka lambar baya sau biyu”, haka kuma ta ƙa’idar “lambar da ake ƙarawa ga wadda ta gabata tana ƙaruwa da 2, kamar 2, 4”. Lambar gaba ta bambanta bisa ƙa’idar, saboda haka yana da wuya a ce 16 ce daga katuna uku kawai.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.prompt: Bari mu gwada kalaman Jihu. Yi lambobi daban-daban guda 2 da za su iya zuwa bayan 2, 4, 8. Lambar gaba dole ta bi ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ƙa’idoji: (가) ƙa’idar da ke ninka lambar baya da wani adadi kowane lokaci, ko (나) ƙa’idar da lambar da ake ƙarawa ga wadda ta gabata ke ƙaruwa da adadi iri ɗaya kowane lokaci.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.0: Farko nemo “sau nawa” da “nawa aka ƙara” daga 2 zuwa 4, da kuma daga 4 zuwa 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta lambar da za ka samu idan ka sake amfani da kowace ƙa’ida ga 8 sau ɗaya.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Lamba ta gaba lamba ce ta halitta mafi girma fiye da 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ka sanya lambar gaba ta zama lamba ta halitta mafi girma fiye da 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Lamba ce da ke bin ɗaya daga cikin ƙa’idojin biyu.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Wannan lambar ba ta biyo bayan 2, 4, 8 bisa ƙa’ida (가) ko (나). Yi amfani da kowace ƙa’ida biyu sau ɗaya ga 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.explain: Bisa ƙa’ida (가), ninkawa biyu, lambar ita ce 16, wato 8 ninki biyu. Bisa ƙa’ida (나), inda ƙarin lambar ke ƙaruwa da 2 kamar 2, 4, 6, ita ce 8+6=14. Daga lambobi ukun iri ɗaya, lambar gaba na iya bambanta.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.prompt: Jihu ta faɗi ƙa’idar da kalmomi: “Lambar da ake ƙarawa ga lambar baya tana ƙaruwa da 2 kowane lokaci.” Bisa wannan ƙa’ida, wace lamba ce a katin da ke zuwa nan da nan bayan 2, 4, 8?
y-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bisa ƙa’idar da aka faɗa maka, fara rubuta lambobin da aka ƙara a 2→4 da 4→8.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.1: Na gaba, rubuta yadda ƙarin ke canzawa sannan ka ƙara shi ga 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.a: Har yanzu kana amfani da ƙa’idar ci gaba ta ninka lambar baya sau biyu. Ƙa’idar da aka faɗa yanzu tana magana ne game da ƙarin lamba.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.b: Ka bar ƙarin lambar a 4. A ƙa’idar da aka faɗa maka, ƙarin lambar tana bambanta kowane lokaci.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.c: Wannan shi ne tunanin ci gaba da lambobin ƙarin a matsayin 2, 4, 6.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.d: Ka ƙara 2 ga 8. Ci gaba da tsarin da ƙarin lambar ya tashi daga 2 zuwa 4.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.explain: Idan aka bayar da ƙa’ida da kalmomi, lambar gaba tana kayyaduwa guda ɗaya. Lambobin ƙarin su ne 2, 4, 6, don haka 8+6=14. Idan lambobi kaɗan kawai aka bayar, lambar gaba ba lallai ta kayyadu guda ɗaya ba; tana kayyaduwa idan aka faɗa maka ƙa’idar ko lamba ɗaya ta gaba.

y-m-11-07.title: Shekarun Minseo da yayarta, bayani ga ƙanwar/ƙanin dan'uwanta
y-m-11-07.topic: Bayyana dangantakar da ke ƙara adadi tabbatacce, kamar bambancin shekaru, da kalmomi da misalai
y-m-11-07.goal: Nemo a jadawali dangantakar da bambanci tabbatacce yake nan yadda yake, kamar shekaru; nemo ƙimomi, sannan sake rubuta dangantakar da kalmomi da misalai da ƙanwar/ƙanin ɗalibin aji na 2 zai fahimta.
y-m-11-07.material: Minseo da yayarta suna ƙirga shekarunsu daga ranar haihuwar su a shekara ɗaya (kowace shekara dukansu suna ƙara shekara ɗaya). Idan Minseo tana da shekara 4, yayarta 7; Minseo shekara 5, yayarta 8; Minseo shekara 6, yayarta 9. Minseo tana son gaya wa dan'uwanta/yar'uwarta na aji na 2 yadda ake ƙayyade shekarun yayarta.
y-m-11-07.thinking.0: Nemo dangantaka (bambanci tabbatacce) a jadawali da hasashen sabuwar ƙima
y-m-11-07.thinking.1: Sauya bayani domin ya dace da mai sauraro
y-m-11-07.thinking.2: Bincika da misali ko bayanin daidai ne
y-m-11-07.s.s1.prompt: Idan Minseo ta cika shekara 10, yayarta za ta yi shekara nawa?
y-m-11-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace ƙwaya cikin ukun jadawali, nemo bambancin shekarun yayarta da na Minseo.
y-m-11-07.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko bambancin iri ɗaya ne ko ya bambanta a kowace ƙwaya, ka kwatanta yawan shekarun da kowanne cikin biyun ke ƙaruwa a kowace shekara.
y-m-11-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka ƙara shekarun yayarta na farko 7 ga shekarun Minseo 10. Bincika ko hanyar daidai ce ta gwada a jadawalin inda yayarta take 7 lokacin da Minseo ke 4.
y-m-11-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauka a matsayin ninki 2 na shekarun Minseo. Duba ko ninki 2 ya dace a ƙwayoyin shekaru 5 da 6 na jadawali.
y-m-11-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauka bambancin shekarun Minseo da yayarta 4 ne. Nemo bambancin shekarunsu a ƙwaya ɗaya na jadawali.
y-m-11-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ra'ayi ne na amfani da gaskiyar cewa shekarun biyun suna ƙaruwa da adadi ɗaya a kowace shekara.
y-m-11-07.s.s1.explain: A ƙwayoyi ukun jadawali, yayarta ta girme Minseo da shekara 3 (7-4=3, 8-5=3, 9-6=3). Kowace shekara dukansu suna ƙara shekara ɗaya, don haka bambancin ba ya canzawa. Saboda haka idan Minseo ta cika shekara 10, yayarta za ta yi shekara 13.
y-m-11-07.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi bayanin da ya fi dacewa Minseo ta aika wa ƙanwar/ƙanin ta (aji na 2).
y-m-11-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka duba ko kowane bayani ya dace da ƙwayoyi ukun jadawali.

y-m-11-02.title: Kallon lissafin Minsu a teburin kwalin tuffa
y-m-11-02.topic: Karanta alaƙar adadi biyu a tebur ka rubuta ta a matsayin lissafi (alaƙar da ke ƙaruwa da adadi iri ɗaya)
y-m-11-02.goal: Gwada lissafin da yake daidai a tantanin tebur guda ɗaya kawai a dukkan sauran tantanin, ka gyara shi, sannan ka rubuta alaƙar iri ɗaya a matsayin lissafi ta hanyoyi biyu.
y-m-11-02.material:
Wani shagon ’ya’yan itace yana sayar da tuffa a kwalaye. Kowace kwalin tana ɗauke da adadin tuffa iri ɗaya. Minsu ya tsara yawan kwalaye da yawan tuffa a tebur.
Idan kwalin 1 ce, akwai tuffa 5; idan kwalaye 2 ne, tuffa 10 ne; idan kwalaye 3 ne, tuffa 15 ne.
Minsu ya ce, “Idan ka ƙara 4 ga yawan kwalaye, za ka samu yawan tuffa.”
y-m-11-02.thinking.0: Nemo kuskure a gama-gadin da yake daidai a tantanin tebur guda ɗaya kawai
y-m-11-02.thinking.1: Tabbatar da lissafi ta amfani da tantanin tebur da dama
y-m-11-02.thinking.2: Rubuta alaƙa iri ɗaya a matsayin wani lissafi daban
y-m-11-02.prereq.0: Karanta teburin adadi biyu da ke canzawa tare (matakin aji na 3–4)
y-m-11-02.prereq.1: Tushen lissafi da lambobin halitta (matakin aji na 3)
y-m-11-02.s.s1.prompt: Bi tunanin Minsu. Wane layi ne yake da wuya a yarda da shi? Zaɓi layi ɗaya.
y-m-11-02.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane layi, ware layukan da suka kwafi lambobin tebur yadda suke daga layukan da suka yanke sabon hukunci.
y-m-11-02.s.s1.hint.1: Saka lissafin da ke cikin layin da ya yanke sabon hukunci cikin sauran tantanin tebur, sannan ka kwatanta da ƙimomin tebur.
y-m-11-02.s.s1.line.0: Idan kwalin 1 ce, akwai tuffa 5, kuma 1 da 4 sun zama 5.
y-m-11-02.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka ina tsammanin ƙara 4 ga yawan kwalaye koyaushe yana ba da yawan tuffa.
y-m-11-02.s.s1.line.3: Idan aka yi amfani da wannan lissafi ga kwalaye 3, 3 da 4 sun zama tuffa 7.
y-m-11-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne matsalar. An duba shi ne kawai a tantanin farko na tebur (kwali 1), sannan aka ce “koyaushe”. Saboda haka layi na 4 ya ba da 7, amma tebur ya nuna 15 idan kwalaye 3 ne. Layuka na 1 da 2 sun kwafi tebur, don haka suna da kyau. Daidai a tantanin guda ɗaya ba ya nufin daidai ne a kowanne tantani.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk alaƙokin da suke daidai a dukkan tantanin ukun tebur.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.hint.0: Saka lambobin tantanin farko, na biyu, da na uku na tebur cikin kowace lissafi bi da bi.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.hint.1: Farko soke lissafin da ba daidai ba ne a ko da ɗaya daga tantanin ukun.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.r.a: 1+5=6, wanda ya bambanta da tuffa 5 tun a tantanin farko.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.r.b: Wannan zaɓi ne da ya gwada tantanin ukun tebur da alaƙar ninka yawan kwalaye da 5.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.r.c: Jawaban ieu leres dina kotak kahiji, tapi pariksa dina kotak kadua (2 kotak).
y-m-11-02.s.s2.r.d: Hubungan anu sarua ogé bisa dibaca sabalikna, nyaéta nangtukeun jumlah kotak tina jumlah apel.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.r.e: Ngan dina kotak kahiji hasilna 4. Teangan bédana dina kotak kadua.
y-m-11-02.s.s2.explain: Lamun jumlah kotak dikali 5, hasilna jumlah apel (1×5=5, 2×5=10, 3×5=15); lamun jumlah apel dibagi 5, hasilna jumlah kotak. Dua persamaan éta nétélakeun hubungan anu sarua ti dua arah. Persamaan séjén ngan leres dina hiji atawa dua kotak.
y-m-11-02.s.s3.prompt: Minsu hayang ngabenerkeun persamaan kahijina. Tuliskeun kumaha cara anu hadé pikeun ngabenerkeunana jeung kumaha mariksa naha persamaan éta leres.
y-m-11-02.s.s3.hint.0: Lebetkeun angka tina kotak kadua tabel kana persamaan anu kakara dijieun.
y-m-11-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kahiji, tuliskeun persamaanna ku kecap-kecap: “Lamun kotakna nambahan hiji, sabaraha apel anu nambahan?”
y-m-11-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun sorangan ngasupkeun angka pikeun mariksa yén persamaan anu geus dibenerkeun téh leres ogé dina kotak séjén, lain ukur dina kotak kahiji?
y-m-11-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun ngajelaskeun hubungan jumlah kotak jeung jumlah apel maké kecap “sabaraha unggalna”?
y-m-11-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun nyaho yén hubungan éta bisa ditulis ku persamaan séjén?
y-m-11-02.s.s3.model.0: Benerkeun jadi persamaan anu ngali jumlah kotak ku 5 (jumlah kotak × 5 = jumlah apel). Kuring mariksa yén tilu kotak dina tabel kabéh leres: 1×5=5, 2×5=10, 3×5=15.
y-m-11-02.s.s3.model.1: Unggal kotak eusina 5 apel, jadi jumlah apel nambahan 5: 5, 10, 15. Ku kituna kuring nulis jumlah apel ÷ 5 = jumlah kotak, sarta bisa mariksa yén 15÷5=3 bener ngahasilkeun 3 kotak.
y-m-11-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Jawaban anu ditulis minangka persamaan bagi sarta dipariksa sahenteuna dina hiji kotak

y-m-11-08.s.s1.st.2.after: 99=3+4×24, saboda haka zai bayyana a matsayin lamba ta 25. Kasancewa mara even alama ce da ake buƙata domin lamba ta bayyana, amma ba duk lambobi marasa even ke bayyana ba (misali, 5 da 9 ba sa bayyana a tsarin nan). Hukuncin cewa dole a bincika daban ma ya dace.

y-m-11-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan tunani yana ƙoƙarin fahimtar ko alamar kasancewa mara even ta isa.
y-m-11-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Zai bayyana. Ƙaruwa da 4 daga 3 sau 24 yana ba da 99.
y-m-11-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan tunani ya bincika 99 bisa yawan ƙarin da aka yi daga lambar farawa.
y-m-11-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ba zai bayyana ba. 100 ba ya bayyana, saboda haka 99 ma ba ya bayyana.
y-m-11-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Gaskiyar cewa 100 bai bayyana ba ba ta gaya maka komai game da 99, lambar da ke kusa da shi.

y-m-11-04.title: Motong bagian 3×3 tina kalénder
y-m-11-04.topic: Manggihan hubungan antara angka anu padeukeut ka gigir jeung ka handap dina pola angka kalénder
y-m-11-04.goal: Jieun conto sorangan pikeun mariksa yén jumlah angka dina bagian 3×3 kalénder siga kelipatan angka tengah, sarta terangkeun ku cara masangkeun naha éta tetep leres sanajan jumlah kotak dina unggal jajar robah.
y-m-11-04.material:
Ieu kalénder pikeun bulan anu boga 31 poé. Tanggal 1 nyaéta Minggu, sarta unggal jajar boga 7 kotak (Min, Sen, Sel, Rab, Kem, Jum, Sét). Jajar kahiji 1~7, kadua 8~14, katilu 15~21, kaopat 22~28, sarta kalima 29, 30, 31. Lamun pindah hiji kotak ka katuhu, angkana nambahan 1; lamun turun hiji kotak, angkana nambahan 7.
Harin motong wangun pasagi (9 kotak), 3 kotak ka gigir jeung 3 ka handap tina kalénder, tuluy ngajumlahkeun salapan angkana sarta ngomong, “Sigana ieu kelipatan angka dina kotak tengah!” [9]

y-m-11-05.title: Lamun hiji sisi jadi dua kali, naha sisi séjén ogé jadi dua kali?
y-m-11-05.topic: Ngabandingkeun kumaha robahna kuantitas séjén nalika salah sahiji tina dua kuantitas anu robah babarengan jadi dua kali lipet
y-m-11-05.goal: Tina opat tabel, pilih kaayaan nalika kuantitas séjén pas jadi dua kali lipet waktu hiji sisi digandakeun, sarta terangkeun ku conto bantahan yén bener dina dua kasus teu hartina bener dina sakabéh kasus.

- Pangiriman: 1 kg 3000 won, 2 kg 4000 won, 4 kg 6000 won
- Luas pasagi: sisi 1 cm, 1 cm²; sisi 2 cm, 4 cm²; sisi 4 cm, 16 cm² (dibaca séntiméter pasagi)
- Kéliling pasagi: sisi 1 cm, 4 cm; sisi 2 cm, 8 cm; sisi 4 cm, 16 cm
